reports.coverage: R1a exclusive operating cart and standing production coach train. Sampled planar-envelope check: 0.25 m cart samples plus joins and endpoints, no height discrimination and no continuous swept volume. Excluded: no 3D undercarriage/wheel contact certificate for spur or idle leg turnout blades, wing/check/closure rails, frog, timbers or tie plates (planar bodies would overlap their running surfaces). Trees use trunk boxes only: crown, branch and foliage contact at engine/coach roof height, wind sway, hardwood-specific crown shapes and root seats are not certified. Dynamic players, dropped cargo, loading motion and future train movement are excluded.
